description_en: Enter the state of Ihram at the Miqat. Perform ghusl, wear the two white seamless sheets, and make the intention (niyyah) for Hajj.
description_id: Masuk ke keadaan Ihram di Miqat. Mandi sunat, pakai dua helai kain putih tanpa jahitan, dan niatkan Hajj.
dua_translation_en: Here I am, O Allah, for Hajj.
dua_translation_id: Aku datang memenuhi panggilan-Mu ya Allah untuk menunaikan Hajj.

description_en: Upon arriving at Masjid Al-Haram, perform Tawaf Al-Qudum (Arrival Tawaf) — circle the Kaaba 7 times counterclockwise, starting from the Black Stone (Hajar Al-Aswad).
description_id: Setibanya di Masjidil Haram, lakukan Tawaf Qudum — mengelilingi Ka'bah 7 kali berlawanan arah jam, dimulai dari Hajar Aswad.
dua_translation_en: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
dua_translation_id: Dengan nama Allah, dan Allah Maha Besar.

description_en: Walk 7 times between the hills of Safa and Marwah, commemorating Hajar's search for water for her son Ismail.
description_id: Berjalan 7 kali antara bukit Safa dan Marwah, mengenang pencarian air Hajar untuk putranya Ismail.
dua_arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
dua_translation_en: Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.
dua_translation_id: Sesungguhnya Safa dan Marwah adalah sebahagian dari syiar Allah.

description_en: Travel to Mina on the 8th of Dhul Hijjah (Tarwiyah Day). Stay overnight and pray Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, and Fajr.
description_id: Berangkat ke Mina pada 8 Dzulhijjah (Hari Tarwiyah). Bermalam dan shalat Dzuhur, Ashar, Maghrib, Isya, dan Subuh.
dua_translation_en: Spend the day in worship and remembrance of Allah.
dua_translation_id: Isi hari dengan ibadah dan dzikir kepada Allah.

description_en: The most important day of Hajj. Stand at Arafah from Dhuhr until sunset in prayer and supplication. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Hajj is Arafah.'
description_id: Hari terpenting dalam Hajj. Wukuf di Arafah dari Dzuhur hingga matahari terbenam, berdoa dan berdzikir. Rasulullah ﷺ bersabda: 'Hajj adalah Arafah.'
dua_arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
dua_transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
dua_translation_en: There is no god but Allah alone with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent.
dua_translation_id: Tiada Tuhan selain Allah Yang Maha Esa, tiada sekutu bagi-Nya. Milik-Nya segala kerajaan dan pujian, dan Dia Maha Kuasa atas segala sesuatu.

description_en: After sunset at Arafah, travel to Muzdalifah. Pray Maghrib and Isha combined. Collect pebbles (7 + 49 for the next days). Stay overnight under the stars.
description_id: Setelah matahari terbenam di Arafah, berangkat ke Muzdalifah. Shalat Maghrib dan Isya dijamak. Kumpulkan batu kerikil (7 + 49 untuk hari berikutnya). Bermalam di bawah bintang.
dua_translation_en: Rest and worship — this is a night of preparation.
dua_translation_id: Beristirahat dan beribadah — ini malam persiapan.

description_en: Stone the largest pillar (Jamarat Al-Aqaba) with 7 pebbles. Say 'Allahu Akbar' with each throw. This commemorates Ibrahim's rejection of Shaytan.
description_id: Lempar jumrah terbesar (Jamarat Al-Aqabah) dengan 7 batu kerikil. Ucapkan 'Allahu Akbar' setiap lemparan. Ini mengenang penolakan Ibrahim terhadap godaan setan.

description_en: Offer the sacrificial animal (Hady). Then shave (Halq) or trim (Taqsir) your hair. This marks the partial exit from Ihram.
description_id: Sembelih hewan kurban (Hady). Kemudian cukur (Halq) atau pendekkan (Taqsir) rambut. Ini menandai tahallul awal — keluar sebagian dari Ihram.
dua_translation_en: After this, you can change into regular clothes but marital relations remain prohibited.
dua_translation_id: Setelah ini, Anda boleh berganti pakaian biasa namun hubungan suami istri masih dilarang.

description_en: Return to Makkah and perform Tawaf Al-Ifadah — the essential Tawaf of Hajj. Circle the Kaaba 7 times.
description_id: Kembali ke Mekah dan lakukan Tawaf Ifadhah — Tawaf rukun Hajj. Kelilingi Ka'bah 7 kali.
dua_translation_en: This Tawaf is a pillar of Hajj — without it, Hajj is incomplete.
dua_translation_id: Tawaf ini adalah rukun Hajj — tanpanya Hajj tidak sah.

description_en: Stone all three pillars on the 11th, 12th, and optionally 13th of Dhul Hijjah (7 pebbles each). Before leaving Makkah, perform Tawaf Al-Wada (Farewell Tawaf).
description_id: Lempar ketiga jumrah pada 11, 12, dan opsional 13 Dzulhijjah (masing-masing 7 batu). Sebelum meninggalkan Mekah, lakukan Tawaf Wada' (Tawaf Perpisahan).
dua_translation_en: Your Hajj is now complete. May Allah accept it.
dua_translation_id: Hajj Anda kini selesai. Semoga Allah menerimanya.
